name: MemberOnboardingInductionTracker
tagline: Every new member's first 90 days – inductions, programs, classes, PT tasters, check-in calls and early-churn alerts in one app.
description: A complete onboarding module for gyms, health clubs and leisure centres. Book inductions in a clash-free coach diary, track milestone targets per journey day, log check-in calls, see visit pace and an early-churn score with next-best actions, and nudge members through your own flows. Works in Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages, with demo data the moment it is dropped on a screen.
features: 90-day milestone targets (induction, program, first class, PT taster, 30/60/90-day calls)
Drag-and-drop journey board with stage rules
Coach induction diary with clash and capacity checks
Early-churn score with reasons and next-best actions
Bulk nudges via OnAction (SMS/Email/App push templates)
Join cohort and coach workload analytics
Create/edit with validation, warnings and undo
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
